subject: Subscription triage ops and risk heatcheck — ClearPath renewal
messages:
From: Aidan Cole <aidan@clearpath.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Subscription renewal timing & preliminary numbers

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Per our convo, I'm attaching our export with current seat counts and expected growth for Q1. We're targeting a 2027-01-15 renewal date on the enterprise subscription (renewal window opened early because of changes in our internal procurement cycle).

Key notes:
- Current ARR tied to Redwood: $185,000 (listed in tab "FY26 ARR")
- Two product teams have open churn risk flags (one has hiring freeze)
- Procurement wants a firm renewal timeline and a list of any pricing/commit implications for committed capacity

Can your team confirm the committed seats and any potential discounts/credits that might apply if we lock by Dec 15?

Attachments: ClearPath_Renewal_Q4_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 220KB)

Thanks,
Aidan
Head of Ops | ClearPath Analytics
Aidan.Cole@clearpath.io

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Aidan Cole <aidan@clearpath.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subscription renewal timing & preliminary numbers

Hi Aidan — thanks for sending this over and outlining the timeline. Looping in Ben (CS lead) and Marissa/Naomi from Rev/FinOps to do a quick triage on ARR and risk flags.

Ben/Marissa/Naomi — can each of you confirm the following by EOD Friday?
1) Verified committed ARR for ClearPath in our system (including any reserved capacity credits).
2) Any known churn risk indicators on listed seats (team ahead of renewal that has hiring freeze) — flag owner and severity (low/medium/high).
3) Pricing levers we can offer if ClearPath signs before Dec 15 (standard renew/bulk-seat thresholds, one-time onboarding credit, or short-term discount).

I've attached an editable workbook where I made a few initial reconciliations; please update the "RDW ops" tab with final numbers and flag rows requiring escalation. We'll run a 30-min subscription-triage mini-sprint next Tuesday to lock commit states.

Attachments: renewal_spreadsheet_Q4_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

On Wed, 11 Nov 2026 at 10:48, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben/Marissa/Naomi — can each of you confirm the following by EOD Friday?

Quick update from my side: I reconciled seat counts against usage logs and the ClearPath export.
- Confirmed ARR: $183,500 (system vs. ClearPath difference due to two inactive seats)
- Risk flags: 3 seat groups marked medium risk (Product A lead; Finance PO on hold; Site reliability has hiring freeze)
- Suggested short-term levers: offer 3% on annual commit if they sign before Dec 15, or a one-time $5k onboarding credit tied to migration support.

I'll add line-item notes in "renewal_spreadsheet_Q4_v2.xlsx" and tag rows that need NAO (contract/legal) review.

Ben
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subscription renewal timing & preliminary numbers

Thanks for the fast turnaround, everyone — and thanks Aidan for confirming procurement timing. Summary / action items from the triage so far:
- Reconciled ARR to $183.5k (Ben) — we will use this as the committed baseline.
- Risk: three medium-risk seat groups identified. CS will assign owners and create short bulleted mitigation per owner by Friday 11/20.
- Commercial levers: tentative offer of 3% annual-commit discount if ClearPath locks before 12/15 OR $5k onboarding credit tied to migration milestones. NAO to confirm any concession language.

Next steps (owners):
- Ben: finalize "RDW ops" tab, flag NAO rows, and add seat-level owners (due 11/20).
- Marissa: run pricing impact for both 3% discount and $5k credit and give estimated net ARR/ACV implications (due 11/20).
- Naomi: create a short invoice/credit schedule and validate accounting treatment for a $5k onboarding credit (due 11/20).
- Kimberly: schedule 30-min subscription-triage mini-sprint for 11/23 at 09:00 PST; invite includes a short agenda (confirm commit, finalize levers, next steps).

Aidan/procurement@clearpath.io — we'll send a one-page mutual action plan after our mini-sprint; please confirm your availability for 11/23 09:00 PST.
